clusters.name: Your grandfather Amos's death, 1989–1990
clusters.reason: Around your grandfather Amos dying in July 1989, within the following months: your mother's worry over money in March 1988 and her distance from your father on money talk in May 1988, your grandfather's death in July 1989, your brother Felix's grades falling in November 1989, and your mother calmer once back at work in March 1990. The shifts cluster around the grandfather's death, with your mother's earlier money worry and distance from your father setting the family's balance, and your brother's functioning falling after the death while your mother's anxiety eased when she returned to work.

clusters.name: Your mother Della told she had breast cancer, 1993–1996
clusters.reason: You left home for college in September 1993; in March 1994 migraines kept you in bed, in April 1994 you called your brother most nights, in February 1995 your mother was told she had breast cancer, in June 1995 you stopped returning your brother's calls, and in February 1996 you stopped calling home. Your symptoms and shifts toward and away from your brother cluster around your mother's diagnosis, with your calls to your brother reaching their height just before her cancer was named and then reversing after it.
